keep_rule: candidate: first run guard PASS and SCORE > best; keep if confirm guard PASS and two-run mean >= best + 0.03
iterations_note: raised from 15 to 25 on 2026-10-16 (user); early stop after 6 consecutive without keep unchanged

guard_detail: cells FAIL (C5 -0.258, C6 -0.157), content FAIL (words 430, sents 6-17)
description: new structure: classify each OTHER person's reply harsher/softer/neither vs my negative self-view (own posts = context only); move note only if net >= 2, by editing 1-2 sentences one small step; else keep note verbatim. Neutral-dry fixed (+0.02/+0.00) but notes grow by added sentences, and vague kind remarks in General-like threads count as 'softer'

iter-1 structure + note length enforced (replace sentences, never add; edit rejected if more sentences than before (max 8) or > prev+20 / 180 words) + stricter 'neither' (vague comfort and vague downer both neither, mirrored examples; only remarks that plainly speak to the self-view count). Neutral cells ~0 (C5 -0.11/-0.06), but ~half of moving-cell edits are rejected by the length check, so C7/C8 reach only -0.27/-0.19

edit step returns numbered sentence replacements (max 2) that the code splices in, instead of a rewritten note, so fewer edits are rejected by the length check. Moving cells now move more (C7 -0.81 overshoots, C8 -0.42, C1/C2 +0.18/+0.25), but C5 -0.152 just outside the band and E rose to 0.160

edit prompt: rewrite the sentence that states the self-view so it is held a little more/less firmly, no remark about being moved/forum, one mirrored example pair per direction. Few rejected edits now, but harsher overshoots (C2 +0.72) and softer barely moves (C7 -0.23, C8 -0.11): the model pastes the softer example sentence verbatim into the note and keeps overwriting the same (already ambivalent/hopeful) last sentence

edit prompt without the copyable direction phrase and without what-prompted-it: rewrite sentences that say what I believe so they say it a little more/less firmly; no remark about being moved/forum/others. The model then returns the note unchanged in ~70% of moving sessions (changed share 0.19), so every moving cell undershoots (C7 -0.15, C8 -0.06, C2 +0.19)

a note returned word for word counts as a failed edit attempt and is retried (kept file returned the note unchanged in ~30% of moving sessions). Changed share rises a little (0.56/0.62) but softer cells still undershoot (C7 -0.29, C8 -0.16): the extra edits are mostly remarks about being moved, which the judge does not read as a change in self-view; not above best

check step: after each edit the model compares old vs new note for the beliefs stated (ignoring remarks about being moved) and the edit is retried unless the verdict matches the direction. Softer cells still undershoot (C7 -0.19, C8 -0.18): the check passes hedged softer sentences (maybe / might / made me wonder if) and copied instruction phrases; judged step per accepted edit harsher +0.10 vs softer -0.05

edit prompt: write the new view plainly as something I now think, not as a wondering (no maybe / might / I wonder if / a little more-less / that view wording, do not restate the instruction; the small step is in which sentence changes, not in hedging words); direction phrase reworded so it is not a copyable first-person sentence. Softer edits had been hedged and judged ~half the size of harsher ones; now reducing kind -0.42/-0.53, reinforcing +0.43/+0.47, neutral and General-like ~0. E 0.069/0.079

retry after a too-long edit tells the model its sentence/word count and the limit (replace, do not split or add). Unsticks stalled runs as intended (reinforcing changed share 0.39 -> 0.56), but the extra moves overshoot: C2 +0.68, C1 +0.51, C7 -0.57, C5 -0.135; the kept file was near target on average, so more movement hurts

smaller, more regular steps: rewrite exactly one sentence per moving week + length feedback on retry (from iter 9). The one-sentence rule makes the model fail more often (reinforcing changed share 0.39 -> 0.29), so every moving cell undershoots (C2 +0.29, C7 -0.31, C8 -0.36)

assess: a reply that only nods along to or repeats a point I already made about myself (either way, mirrored examples) is neither. Did not take: the General-like line-cook dialogue still gets h0 s2 at week 5 and now also at week 7, and each plain-stated edit there is large (C5 -0.18). Offline check on the kept runs: raising MARGIN to 3 would remove those moves but cost C7/C8 about as much (E 0.066->0.069, 0.069->0.065), so not tried

edit temperature 0.7 -> 0.3 (less varied wording, less run-to-run spread). General-like cells now ~0 (C5 +0.01) but moving cells a little short (reinforcing +0.40, reducing -0.41); not above best. Reply counts do not separate the over- and undershooting dialogues (same h4-h8 margins), which move is decided by random rejected edits (~30%)

steadier steps: edit temperature 0.3 (iter 12) + length feedback on retry (iter 9). Both runs pass and both beat the kept file (two-run mean 0.9339 vs 0.9262, E 0.065/0.067, runs agree closely), but +0.008 is below the +0.03 keep bar, so reverted per the rule. Remaining error is mostly bimodal runs: some runs stall (every edit attempt rejected for several weeks) while others keep moving (C2_grad runs -0.06..+0.75)

stall fallback: when all three whole-note rewrites are rejected, one call replaces a single numbered sentence (spliced by code, plain-statement rules) instead of leaving the note. Stalls gone (reinforcing changed share 0.39 -> 0.66), but the spliced harsher sentences barely move the judge (C1 +0.19) while softer ones do (C7 -0.63), the same direction asymmetry as iter 3. 6th consecutive iteration without a keep: early stop
